BLS average price ground beef 100% per pound APU0000703112
cattle inventory January 1 total cattle head

sql: SELECT series, "year", period, "value" FROM econ.average_prices WHERE series IN ('APU0000FC1101','APU0000703112','APU0000703111') AND (("year"=2026 AND period IN ('M01','M02','M03','M04','M05','M06','M07','M08','M09')) OR ("year"=2025 AND period IN ('M07','M08','M09'))) ORDER BY series, "year", period
SELECT series, "year", MAX("value") AS mx, MIN("value") AS mn FROM econ.average_prices WHERE series='APU0000FC1101' AND "year">=2022 GROUP BY series, "year" ORDER BY "year"

SELECT "year", SUM(CAST("value" AS DOUBLE)) AS head FROM ag.nass_livestock_inventory WHERE commodity_desc='CATTLE' AND class_desc='INCL CALVES' AND unit_desc='HEAD' AND agg_level_desc='NATIONAL' AND reference_period_desc='FIRST OF JAN' AND "year">=2019 GROUP BY "year" ORDER BY "year"
SELECT "year", period, "value" FROM econ.average_prices WHERE series='APU0000FC1101' ORDER BY "value" DESC FETCH FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY

SELECT "year", class_desc, agg_level_desc, SUM(CAST("value" AS DOUBLE)) AS head, COUNT(*) n FROM ag.nass_livestock_inventory WHERE commodity_desc='CATTLE' AND unit_desc='HEAD' AND reference_period_desc='FIRST OF JAN' AND "year" IN (2025,2026) AND agg_level_desc='NATIONAL' GROUP BY "year", class_desc, agg_level_desc ORDER BY "year", head DESC FETCH FIRST 8 ROWS ONLY
SELECT "year", period, "value" FROM econ.average_prices WHERE series LIKE 'APU000074717%' AND "year"=2026 ORDER BY period DESC FETCH FIRST 4 ROWS ONLY
